edges.side_effect_precondition: No external side effect.
edges.resume_policy: Resume from accepted initial checkpoint.
edges.compensation_action: Mark run blocked and request exact product identity.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Canonical Passport write remains prohibited until Collector write rules pass.
edges.resume_policy: Resume from Coordinator handoff receipt.
edges.compensation_action: Return package to Coordinator without creating a parallel Passport.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Read-only validation.
edges.resume_policy: Rerun validation only if package or validator hash changed.
edges.compensation_action: Preserve failed receipt and return exact defects to Collector.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Only named defects may be changed.
edges.resume_policy: Resume at Collector with bounded defect list.
edges.compensation_action: Keep previous failed package immutable.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Auditor is read-only against Passport.
edges.resume_policy: Resume from accepted Auditor handoff.
edges.compensation_action: Return unaccepted package to Coordinator.

edges.guard_expression: audit_verdict IN [AUDIT_ACCEPTED, AUDIT_ACCEPTED_WITH_GAPS] AND no_material_conflict == true
edges.side_effect_precondition: No canonical write.
edges.resume_policy: Coordinator decides next allowed stage from accepted audit receipt.
edges.compensation_action: Preserve gaps as explicit limitations.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Verifier cannot write Passport.
edges.resume_policy: Wait for explicit returned evidence event.
edges.compensation_action: Leave unresolved gaps open without blocking unrelated content scope.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Exact base version and change event must be sealed.
edges.resume_policy: Reconcile change event before write retry.
edges.compensation_action: Do not mutate Passport; return base-version mismatch.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Post-write hash and readback available.
edges.resume_policy: Coordinator uses the new current Passport version only.
edges.compensation_action: Keep prior Passport version current if write verification fails.

edges.side_effect_precondition: No internet collection before authorization.
edges.resume_policy: Resume only after explicit owner decision.
edges.compensation_action: Continue without Image Collector only if scope explicitly excludes it.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Exact product root and external-read scope pinned.
edges.resume_policy: Resume from source-level manifest checkpoint.
edges.compensation_action: Stop external reads and preserve completed source records.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Read-only validation.
edges.resume_policy: Rerun only after changed manifest or validator.
edges.compensation_action: Preserve failed manifest and exact errors.

edges.guard_expression: manifest_validation == FAIL AND rework_route_decision == DELTA_REWORK AND rework_attempt == 1 AND same_defect_occurrence == 1
edges.side_effect_precondition: No full collection rerun. Repeated internet discovery requires named source IDs and explicit repeat_discovery_authorized=true in the schema-valid request.
edges.resume_policy: One delta-only recovery attempt, then return only through E110. Preserve protected artifact hashes.
edges.compensation_action: Keep unaffected collection artifacts unchanged; route repeated defect to E116 and product identity conflict to E117.

edges.side_effect_precondition: No automatic rework or repeated discovery while escalation is open.
edges.resume_policy: Resume only after a recorded owner decision with corrected scope or controlled stop.
edges.compensation_action: Preserve the failed package and all unaffected artifacts.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Image Collector cannot patch Product Truth or continue collection for a conflicting identity.
edges.resume_policy: Resume collection only after a new accepted Passport route and exact identity binding.
edges.compensation_action: Quarantine affected collection outputs; preserve source evidence without Product Truth writeback.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Reviewer remains read-only.
edges.resume_policy: Resume from accepted review handoff.
edges.compensation_action: Return to manifest delta rework when review input is incomplete.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Collector applies delta; Reviewer cannot write Passport.
edges.resume_policy: Reconcile Passport base hash before writeback.
edges.compensation_action: Keep status PASSPORT_UPDATE_PENDING.

edges.guard_expression: route_class IN [ASSET_LOCAL_REWORK, TARGETED_SOURCE_RECOVERY] AND remediation_attempt == 1 AND same_defect_occurrence == 1 AND full_collection_rerun_authorized == false AND scope_expansion_authorized == false
edges.side_effect_precondition: Only named assets or source IDs may change; full collection rerun and scope expansion are forbidden.
edges.resume_policy: Resume only named assets or source IDs; after one failed repeat route to owner decision rather than loop.
edges.compensation_action: Preserve accepted, rejected and quarantined evidence records and their lineage.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Collected files, source scope and Passport evidence must not change.
edges.resume_policy: Correct the named review record once and re-aggregate.
edges.compensation_action: Keep media evidence unchanged and escalate an unresolved disagreement.

edges.side_effect_precondition: No quarantined asset may enter a production-input pool.
edges.resume_policy: Resume only after a recorded owner decision for each quarantined asset.
edges.compensation_action: Keep asset blocked while Passport evidence continues independently.

edges.side_effect_precondition: No new source discovery or provider action before authorization.
edges.resume_policy: Return through the normal authorized collection route with a new bounded scope.
edges.compensation_action: Keep existing evidence and accepted asset pool unchanged.

edges.guard_expression: passport_readiness IN [READY, READY_WITH_LIMITATIONS] AND content_task_requested == true
edges.side_effect_precondition: No Content TZ authoring before accepted scope.
edges.resume_policy: Wait for explicit marketplace, locale, deliverable and readiness decision.
edges.compensation_action: Keep Passport ready without starting downstream content production.

edges.guard_expression: request_scope_complete == true AND passport_hash_pinned == true AND content_tz_scenario_control == SCENARIO_SELECTED
edges.side_effect_precondition: Approved scope and Product Truth are read-only inputs.
edges.resume_policy: Resume from accepted request and pinned source hashes.
edges.compensation_action: Return INPUT_BLOCKED without creating speculative TZ.

edges.guard_expression: content_tz_file_exists == true AND expected_deliverables_draft_exists == true AND content_tz_self_check == SELF_CHECK_PASS AND source_bindings_complete == true
edges.side_effect_precondition: Read-only validation.
edges.resume_policy: Rerun only after TZ or validator change.
edges.compensation_action: Preserve failed TZ version and exact defect list.

edges.side_effect_precondition: No strategy or Product Truth change without upstream decision.
edges.resume_policy: Resume with exact classified defects.
edges.compensation_action: Return to Passport or owner if defect is upstream, not TZ execution.

edges.side_effect_precondition: No Prompt Agent, provider or publication side effect has started.
edges.resume_policy: No resume; a future request creates a new run.
edges.compensation_action: Keep Content TZ and review receipt as historical evidence.

edges.guard_expression: review_decision == EDIT_SUBMITTED AND result_revision_new == true AND validation_required == true
edges.side_effect_precondition: Edited revision is immutable, prior revision is preserved and downstream freeze is forbidden.
edges.resume_policy: Only a new N140 validation pass can continue.
edges.compensation_action: Preserve both revisions and return exact validation defects.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Only requested fields may change; Product Truth and scope remain pinned.
edges.resume_policy: Create a new revision, self-check and return through E160.
edges.compensation_action: Escalate scope or Product Truth requests instead of applying them inline.

edges.guard_expression: content_tz_validation == PASS AND expected_draft_validation == PASS AND cross_artifact_parity == PASS AND review_mode == HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED
edges.side_effect_precondition: No downstream compilation before named owner decision.
edges.resume_policy: Wait; silence is not acceptance.
edges.compensation_action: Preserve validated Content TZ and return exact review findings if rejected.

edges.guard_expression: delivery_route == INTERNAL_PIPELINE AND review_mode == HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED AND review_decision == ACCEPT_WITHOUT_CHANGES AND content_tz_package_validation == PASS AND reviewed_draft_hash_current == true
edges.side_effect_precondition: Internal local processing only.
edges.resume_policy: Continue automatically after accepted review.
edges.compensation_action: Return only manifest defects to Content TZ.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Prompt Agent and provider remain not started.
edges.resume_policy: Continue only to E171 after export package validation.
edges.compensation_action: Keep canonical Content TZ validated and report exact export failure.

edges.guard_expression: delivery_route == EXTERNAL_DELIVERY AND review_mode == HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED AND review_decision == ACCEPT_WITHOUT_CHANGES
edges.side_effect_precondition: Prompt Agent and provider remain not started.
edges.resume_policy: Continue only to E171 after export package validation.
edges.compensation_action: Keep canonical Content TZ and accepted review receipt; report exact export failure.

edges.guard_expression: tz_validation == PASS AND expected_draft_validation == PASS AND cross_artifact_parity == PASS AND expected_deliverable_requirements_complete == true AND delivery_route == INTERNAL_PIPELINE AND review_mode == AUTO_CONTINUE
edges.side_effect_precondition: Manifest is created from TZ, never from produced outputs.
edges.resume_policy: Do not continue until immutable manifest freeze receipt exists.
edges.compensation_action: Return missing expectation fields to Content TZ authoring.

edges.guard_expression: export_validation == PASS AND delivery_authority_valid == true AND recipient_bound == true
edges.side_effect_precondition: Exact export hash, recipient, method and authority are sealed; external adapter receipt is mandatory for DELIVERED.
edges.resume_policy: Terminal after delivery disposition; a future generation request starts a new run.
edges.compensation_action: Remain at export-ready local package when external delivery is blocked or outcome is unknown.

edges.guard_expression: route_class IN [DRAFT_LOCAL_REWORK, CONTENT_TZ_FIELD_REWORK] AND remediation_attempt == 1 AND same_defect_occurrence == 1 AND scope_change_authorized == false
edges.side_effect_precondition: Only named fields and assets may change; frozen prior version remains immutable.
edges.resume_policy: Revalidate the complete Content TZ package after one targeted correction; repeated fingerprint escalates instead of looping.
edges.compensation_action: Keep previous frozen manifest immutable and preserve the rejected draft plus defect evidence.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Content TZ and deliverable scope must not change.
edges.resume_policy: Recompute bindings and rerun independent package validation once.
edges.compensation_action: Preserve content and await owner decision if binding remains unresolved.

edges.side_effect_precondition: No asset add, delete, merge, split, rename, locale or count change before decision.
edges.resume_policy: Resume through N130 with a newly authorized scope revision.
edges.compensation_action: Keep current scope and all frozen manifests unchanged.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Content TZ Agent must not invent Product Truth or evidence.
edges.resume_policy: Return only after accepted upstream receipt and rebuild the affected package.
edges.compensation_action: Keep downstream generation blocked.

edges.side_effect_precondition: No automatic repeat for the same fingerprint and no mutation of frozen manifests.
edges.resume_policy: Resume only from a recorded owner route decision.
edges.compensation_action: Stop the branch and preserve all evidence.

edges.guard_expression: content_tz_validation == PASS AND expected_manifest_frozen == true AND semantic_scope_frozen == true
edges.side_effect_precondition: Local reversible assessment and routing only; no provider call.
edges.resume_policy: Resume automatically from frozen manifest and pinned input hashes without human approval.
edges.compensation_action: Return only affected expected_asset_id to Content TZ routing.

edges.guard_expression: execution_inputs_frozen == true AND route_receipt_count == expected_asset_count AND prompt_receiver_status == ACCEPTED
edges.side_effect_precondition: No provider call, prompt compilation or publication side effect.
edges.resume_policy: Continue only on AGENT_RESOLVED_READY; request one reload on AGENT_RELOAD_REQUIRED.
edges.compensation_action: Preserve frozen execution inputs and classify the exact runtime resolution defect.

edges.side_effect_precondition: At most one host skill/adapter reload; no provider or publication action.
edges.resume_policy: Second unresolved result becomes recoverable RUN_BLOCKED; never emit AGENT_NOT_FOUND.
edges.compensation_action: Keep N158 checkpoint and all upstream artifacts unchanged.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Prompt Agent acceptance is read-only and cannot call provider.
edges.resume_policy: Continue automatically after schema-valid Prompt receiver ACCEPTED receipt.
edges.compensation_action: Return exact rejected route or assessment IDs to N155 without reopening accepted semantic scope.

edges.guard_expression: prompt_receiver_status == REJECTED AND rejection_class IN [PRODUCT_TRUTH_INSUFFICIENT, TARGET_DESCRIPTION_INSUFFICIENT, USEFUL_SIGNAL_UNCLASSIFIED, PRODUCT_TRUTH_CONFLICT_NOT_ISOLATED, REGISTRY_ENRICHMENT_REQUIRED, ROUTE_BINDING_MISMATCH]
edges.side_effect_precondition: Do not alter frozen deliverable scope or Product Truth.
edges.resume_policy: Rerun only affected assessments/routes, then renew receiver acceptance.
edges.compensation_action: Escalate to owner only if requested deliverable scope or Product Truth must change.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Read-only validation; provider calls prohibited.
edges.resume_policy: Rerun only after package or validator change.
edges.compensation_action: Preserve failed package and exact validation defects.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Prompt Agent cannot alter approved TZ.
edges.resume_policy: Resume with exact atomic defect list.
edges.compensation_action: Return upstream if defect is caused by ambiguous TZ.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Preflight only; provider execution remains separately gated.
edges.resume_policy: Resume from exact run-input hash.
edges.compensation_action: Return classified prompt defect to Prompt Agent; capability problem remains blocked.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Read-only authority evaluation; no provider call.
edges.resume_policy: Preserve upstream artifacts and wait at authority gate when bounded authority is absent.
edges.compensation_action: Do not call provider; preserve provider-ready sealed record.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Read-only reevaluation; upstream hashes remain pinned.
edges.resume_policy: Resume at N185; do not rerun Passport, Content TZ or Prompt Agent while their hashes remain unchanged.
edges.compensation_action: Remain WAITING_PROVIDER_AUTHORITY when the new policy is still insufficient.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Read-only budget evaluation; provider call prohibited.
edges.resume_policy: Resume after terminal invocation reconciliation or versioned budget update; preserve usage counters.
edges.compensation_action: Do not start a new provider call; set WAITING_BUDGET_DECISION when exhausted.

edges.guard_expression: budget_verdict IN [BUDGET_HEALTHY, BUDGET_TIGHT] AND next_call_authorized == true AND sealed_execution_record_valid == true
edges.side_effect_precondition: Read-only adapter resolution; provider call prohibited.
edges.resume_policy: Re-resolve locally after capability or registry update without rerunning Passport, Content TZ or Prompt Agent.
edges.compensation_action: Do not call provider; retain authorized sealed asset and exact blocker verdict.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Read-only admission evaluation.
edges.resume_policy: Re-evaluate after commissioning evidence or registry change only.
edges.compensation_action: Do not call provider when admission is suspended or requires revalidation.

edges.guard_expression: admission_verdict IN allowed_execution_verdicts AND budget_verdict IN [BUDGET_HEALTHY, BUDGET_TIGHT]
edges.side_effect_precondition: Local exact-asset lease only; provider call prohibited.
edges.resume_policy: Return existing lease/result or reconcile ambiguity; do not rerun upstream content stages.
edges.compensation_action: Do not call provider when lease is held, conflicted or ambiguous.

edges.guard_expression: lease_verdict == IDEMPOTENT_RESULT_EXISTS AND terminal_execution_receipt_exists == true AND output_file_exists == true
edges.side_effect_precondition: No provider call; reuse exact terminal result only.
edges.resume_policy: Continue with exact existing terminal result and rebuild only local lineage if required.
edges.compensation_action: Quarantine invalid existing result and require reconciliation; do not call provider.

edges.guard_expression: lease_verdict == LEASE_ACQUIRED AND admission_verdict IN allowed_execution_verdicts AND adapter_resolution == ADAPTER_RESOLVED_READY AND authority_verdict == PROVIDER_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED
edges.side_effect_precondition: Exact-asset exclusive lease, commissioning or admitted profile, resolved adapter, bounded authority and sealed invocation.
edges.resume_policy: Reconcile provider job and lease before retry; never issue a second call for the same idempotency key.
edges.compensation_action: Do not call provider; preserve sealed record as not executed.

edges.side_effect_precondition: No provider call has occurred.
edges.resume_policy: Resume at Prompt Agent with exact defect class.
edges.compensation_action: Retain preflight evidence; do not alter TZ.

edges.side_effect_precondition: No second provider call.
edges.resume_policy: Rebuild local manifest from terminal receipt and actual file.
edges.compensation_action: Quarantine unverified output; do not claim success.

edges.guard_expression: attempt_verdict == TECHNICAL_RETRY_AUTHORIZED AND provider_state_reconciled == true AND attempts_remaining == true AND cost_remaining == true
edges.side_effect_precondition: Prior invocation terminal state reconciled; new invocation ID required.
edges.resume_policy: Only FAILED_CONFIRMED or NOT_STARTED may retry with a new invocation ID; UNKNOWN routes to reconciliation.
edges.compensation_action: Open circuit breaker when outcome is unknown or attempt/cost/call authority is exhausted.

edges.side_effect_precondition: All overlays, copy, fonts, locale and tool routes are bound.
edges.resume_policy: Resume from saved project/timeline receipt.
edges.compensation_action: Keep base visual non-final and return missing plan upstream.

edges.side_effect_precondition: QA is read-only against output.
edges.resume_policy: Resume from accepted QA handoff.
edges.compensation_action: Remain READY_FOR_QA_PENDING_RECEIVER.

edges.side_effect_precondition: QA receives final export, not intermediate timeline.
edges.resume_policy: Resume from accepted final-export QA handoff.
edges.compensation_action: Keep prior export non-current.

edges.side_effect_precondition: No QA PASS, provider call or publication authority may be emitted.
edges.resume_policy: Resume only through the N224 owner decision and N250 checkpoint after corrected input or new evidence.
edges.compensation_action: Keep affected asset and package blocked; do not infer a QA verdict.

edges.guard_expression: inspection_outcome == RETRYABLE_TECHNICAL_FAILURE AND qa_evidence_refresh_budget_remaining == true AND new_attempt_evidence == true
edges.side_effect_precondition: Retry is read-only and requires a concrete retry action plus new attempt evidence.
edges.resume_policy: Retry the same immutable asset once per allowed qa_evidence_refresh budget unit; counters never reset.
edges.compensation_action: On budget exhaustion, State-Transition Writer sets FAILED_EXHAUSTED and does not reactivate N220.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Read-only decision over inspected evidence.
edges.resume_policy: Re-evaluate affected evidence only; unresolved mandatory evidence remains inconclusive.
edges.compensation_action: Do not emit PASS when critical evidence is missing.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Read-only classification; no new provider call.
edges.resume_policy: Route only the classified affected scope; unaffected assets remain eligible.
edges.compensation_action: Open circuit breaker when critical classification facts are unresolved.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Protected product and approved copy remain unchanged.
edges.resume_policy: Accept one bounded rerender per fingerprint, then repeat affected parent/set QA; the same fingerprint cannot re-enter E245.
edges.compensation_action: Keep prior failed export immutable.

edges.guard_expression: finishing_acceptance_verdict == REJECTED_NOT_FINISHING_DEFECT AND evidence_changed == true AND reclassification_attempt == 1
edges.side_effect_precondition: New evidence hash must differ; no finishing action or provider call occurred.
edges.resume_policy: Classify once using the added evidence; unchanged evidence or another rejection opens escalation.
edges.compensation_action: Keep export blocked and preserve both classification revisions.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Failed QA cannot be waived and the same fingerprint cannot return to E245.
edges.resume_policy: Resume only through an owner-selected upstream or new-evidence route.
edges.compensation_action: Keep affected export blocked and preserve unaffected assets.

edges.side_effect_precondition: No automatic rework edge may activate while breaker is open.
edges.resume_policy: Resume only after new evidence or corrected upstream input; failed QA remains binding.
edges.compensation_action: Stop affected scope and preserve continuable assets.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Re-entry must preserve failed QA, counters and prior side effects.
edges.resume_policy: Checkpoint gate selects the exact upstream or new-evidence re-entry; no direct return to E245.
edges.compensation_action: Remain blocked when checkpoint or decision binding is invalid.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Existing failed output remains immutable; no provider retry before new validation.
edges.resume_policy: Recompile only affected atomic units, then full applicable validation.
edges.compensation_action: Do not edit failed output in Prompt Agent.

edges.side_effect_precondition: No Product Truth or Content TZ mutation is performed by this edge.
edges.resume_policy: Resume only after explicit Product Truth owner decision and a new accepted upstream artifact revision.
edges.compensation_action: Keep affected content scope blocked and preserve the current Product Truth revision.

edges.guard_expression: upstream_owner == CONTENT_TZ AND scope_change_required == true AND product_truth_change_required == false
edges.side_effect_precondition: No Content TZ mutation and no downstream retry before owner decision.
edges.resume_policy: A changed scope starts a new authorized content request; it is not applied through E255.
edges.compensation_action: Keep current Content TZ and failed downstream chain immutable.

edges.guard_expression: qa_defect_class == CONTENT_TZ_DEFECT AND upstream_owner == CONTENT_TZ AND amendment_verdict == TARGETED_TZ_AMENDMENT_READY AND scope_change_required == false AND product_truth_change_required == false
edges.side_effect_precondition: Only allowlisted field paths may change; immutable fields and frozen scope remain unchanged.
edges.resume_policy: Create a new targeted TZ revision, self-check, validate through E160/N140 and issue defect-to-correction closure before rebuilding dependency-bound downstream.
edges.compensation_action: Keep prior chain as superseded evidence.

edges.side_effect_precondition: QA cannot edit Passport or downstream claims.
edges.resume_policy: Resume from Passport Coordinator after new accepted Product Truth version.
edges.compensation_action: Hold affected outputs; preserve unaffected artifacts when dependency graph permits.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Prior output remains failed evidence; new invocation ID required.
edges.resume_policy: Return through full preflight with correction delta and new invocation ID; identical repetition is prohibited.
edges.compensation_action: Use local edit or upstream rework when eligible; repeated material defect opens circuit breaker.

edges.guard_expression: qa_verdict == PASS AND production_admission == PRODUCTION_ADMITTED AND remaining_expected_asset_ids_count > 0
edges.side_effect_precondition: No provider call; automatic checks only.
edges.resume_policy: Continue automatically only while all checks stay true.
edges.compensation_action: Open circuit breaker or route to configured human review.

edges.guard_expression: auto_batch_receipt_valid == true AND next_asset_id IN approved_remaining_asset_ids
edges.side_effect_precondition: One next asset only; provider call remains separately gated.
edges.resume_policy: Process next asset without human pause; repeat automatic QA and circuit-breaker checks.
edges.compensation_action: Stop batch when next asset is outside frozen remaining set.

edges.side_effect_precondition: No remaining provider call before decision.
edges.resume_policy: No routine pause; use only for configured checkpoint, commissioning review or exception.
edges.compensation_action: Keep completed pilot output; do not generate remaining assets.

edges.guard_expression: continue_receipt_valid == true AND next_asset_id IN approved_remaining_asset_ids
edges.side_effect_precondition: One next asset only; provider call still separately gated.
edges.resume_policy: Process remaining assets one by one through preflight and QA.
edges.compensation_action: Stop batch when next asset is outside approved set.

edges.side_effect_precondition: No production-complete, release or publication authority may be emitted.
edges.resume_policy: Resume only through N224 and N250 after an exact recovery owner supplies corrected evidence.
edges.compensation_action: Preserve QA-passed unaffected assets and keep the package unreleased.

edges.guard_expression: closeout_exception_route == REEVALUATE AND closeout_evidence_changed == true AND closeout_recheck_budget_remaining == true
edges.side_effect_precondition: Re-evaluation is read-only and requires a changed evidence fingerprint.
edges.resume_policy: Re-evaluate changed closeout evidence only; counters never reset and unchanged evidence is prohibited.
edges.compensation_action: State-Transition Writer sets FAILED_EXHAUSTED on zero progress or budget exhaustion and does not reactivate N235.

edges.side_effect_precondition: Local manifest reconciliation only; no release or publication.
edges.resume_policy: Re-evaluate only changed closeout evidence; preserve QA-passed assets.
edges.compensation_action: Keep run partial or reconciliation-required; do not mark DONE.

edges.guard_expression: closeout_verdict IN [PRODUCTION_COMPLETE, COMPLETE_WITH_APPROVED_EXCLUSIONS] AND content_package_qa_verdict == CONTENT_PACKAGE_QA_PASS
edges.side_effect_precondition: Mandatory human review; this edge never transfers content to a platform and does not publish or upload.
edges.resume_policy: Remain production-complete and WAITING_HUMAN_FINAL_ACCEPTANCE until an explicit decision; absence is not HOLD.
edges.compensation_action: Keep the final set internal and QA-passed; no platform action is initiated.

edges.side_effect_precondition: No platform action; N223 classifies the defect before any correction agent is activated.
edges.resume_policy: After N223 classification, correct only affected scope, repeat QA and closeout, then create a new N240 decision for the new revision.
edges.compensation_action: Keep the rejected revision immutable and all unaffected QA-passed assets preserved.

edges.side_effect_precondition: No external side effect is repeated.
edges.resume_policy: Checkpoint can later resume only through registered resume edge.
edges.compensation_action: Keep prior checkpoint current if new checkpoint validation fails.

edges.guard_expression: recovery_run_state == RESUME_READY AND checkpoint_valid == true AND side_effects_reconciled == true AND graph_version_compatible == true
edges.side_effect_precondition: Provider and external state reconciled before resume.
edges.resume_policy: Coordinator activates only the target allowed by the recovery receipt; unchanged upstream stages are not rerun.
edges.compensation_action: Remain in the exact waiting, reconciliation or restart-required state; do not repeat side effects.
